test_title: PYST 37: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Where did ISRO conduct the hot test of the semi-cryogenic engine in 2025?

options.text: Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala
Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh
Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre, Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu
ISRO Propulsion Complex, Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu

solution:
The Correct answer is __**ISRO Propulsion Complex, Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC)** is located at **Mahendragiri** in the state of **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It is a specialized facility of the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** dedicated to the research, development, and testing of **propulsion systems**.
 
• The **semi-cryogenic engine**, an advanced technology, is being developed to enhance ISRO’s **launch vehicle capabilities** for carrying heavier payloads.
 
• The hot test conducted at IPRC is a crucial step for verifying the engine's **performance, efficiency, and reliability**.
 
• IPRC is equipped with sophisticated infrastructure for testing **liquid propulsion engines and stages**, making it the ideal location for such advanced testing.
 
• The engine is expected to play a vital role in the future missions of ISRO, including **human spaceflight programs** and heavy satellite launches.
 
• Mahendragiri has been a key site for ISRO's propulsion system development, contributing significantly to India's space exploration capabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala**__

 __
 
• It is named after **Dr. Vikram Sarabhai**, the father of the Indian space program.
 
• Located in **Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala**, it is ISRO's primary center for the development of **launch vehicles, spacecraft systems, and payloads**.
 
• This center specializes in the development and testing of **solid propulsion systems**, unlike the IPRC, which focuses on liquid propulsion.
 
 
 
• **Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh**__
 __
 
• This is ISRO’s **primary launch site**, located on an island in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It is responsible for the assembly, integration, and launch of **satellite launch vehicles**.
 
• While it plays a crucial role in launches, it does not specialize in propulsion system testing like IPRC.
 
 
 
• **Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre, Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu**__
 
 
• This center is also involved in the development of **liquid propulsion systems** for launch vehicles and satellites.
 
• However, the **ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC)** at Mahendragiri is the specific facility for conducting hot tests of semi-cryogenic engines.
